newsitem.title: USA: MAPCO issues $200 mln debt due 2009, 2027.
newsitem.headline: MAPCO issues $200 mln debt due 2009, 2027.

text.p: The following debt issue from MAPCO Inc was priced on Friday, according to co-lead manager J.P. Morgan Securities Inc. Chase Securities was also co-lead manager.
MAPCO is a diversified energy company headquartered in Tulsa, Oklahoma. Its primary businesses include natural gas liquids and petroleum pipelines and marketing.
